```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ISLR)
library(ISLR2)
```
```{r}
data("Auto")
view(Auto)
```


```{r}
str(Auto)
```

```{r}
sapply(Auto[,1:7], range)
```

```{r}
sapply(Auto[,1:7], mean)
sapply(Auto[,1:7], sd)
```

```{r}
Auto.reduced = Auto[-c(10:84),]
sapply(Auto.reduced[,1:7], range)
sapply(Auto.reduced[,1:7], mean)
sapply(Auto.reduced[,1:7], sd)
```

```{r}
pairs(Auto[,1:7])
```
